definition: The group of words of the proportioning grammar: packs, modules, parts, assemblies, members, and the rules that derive a dimension from them.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`proportion` holds the words of the proportioning grammar: packs, assemblies, members and modules", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
